title: Cognitive Bias Simulator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Scenario-based simulator in which learners identify the cognitive bias behind a buyer's hesitation and select the story strategy that addresses it, with explanatory feedback and a summary table.

learningObjectives: Identify which cognitive bias influences a customer's decision and select the appropriate story strategy to address it.
prerequisites: Cognitive Biases and Decision-Making section of Chapter 2

keyQuestions: Identify which cognitive bias influences a customer's decision and select the appropriate story strategy to address it.
commonMisconceptions: All biases work the same way.
assessmentOpportunities: Learner correctly identifies the bias and strategy for all three scenarios on the first attempt.
Learner can explain how loss aversion helps overcome status quo bias.
